World Zero Tab Bar

#3761: the phone tab bar, final

Version 2, after "a little much": the cards already carry the colour and the motion, so the bar steps back. These are real pages on local main at 375px with touch on. The new header, bar, switch and sheet were injected into the live DOM, so the fonts, tokens and cards are all real.

Version 4, final: no top bar on phones

With MOD inside You, the top bar has nothing left to hold, so phones drop it. Every page starts with its own title under the status bar and gains about 48px. For moderators only, the You sheet ends with a Moderation group: the mod-mode switch, and the queue with its count. The mod strip at the top still appears while mod mode is on. That's its job.

Version 3, final: the glyphs carry the wordmark's spectrum

Each glyph is drawn in the wordmark's four-stop cut (red, yellow, green, blue), run corner to corner across its 24px box. It's at full strength on the active tab and 72% on the others, in both themes. The labels keep their ink colours, and the spectrum hairline above the active tab stays. Everything below this section is version 2, kept for the Community screens and the full-page context.

What changed from version 1

  • No colour in the glyphs, no googly eyes, no bounce. They are ink only, in the bar's own text colours.
  • Still not generic: the objects stay World Zero's. Home is a field journal, Tasks a dare ticket, Praxis a tilted Polaroid, Community three heads in a huddle, You your avatar. None of them is a stock house, list, camera or people icon.
  • Active state, quietly: the object turns solid ink with its details cut out (filled when active, outline when not, as on iOS), the label goes to full ink and semibold, and a 28px spectrum hairline sits on the bar's top edge above it. That hairline is the wordmark's own underline cut and the only colour in the bar.
  • Motion: only the hairline moves. It slides to the new tab in about 180ms, and not at all under reduced motion.
  • Flat bar, no binder tabs: one straight edge, 56px, five equal tabs.

The bar in every state

Community: what happens when you tap it

Community is one tab over the two pages that already exist. It lands on Players. Under a single Community title is a Players | Factions switch, the same spectrum-ringed rail the filter bar uses. Each side is today's page unchanged below its old title. Players keeps its Era | All-time toggle, top three, Faction Points summary and full standings. Factions keeps its eight poster cards. The tab remembers which side you were on last.

Why not merge them into one new page? Players already summarises the factions (Faction Points, "4 more factions"), and the Factions page is a tall wall of posters made for browsing and joining. Merging would mean designing a third page that is worse at both jobs. With the switch, nothing on either page changes and nothing gets a new route. One small join: "4 more factions" on the Players side flips the switch to Factions instead of leaving the tab.

Notes and stand-ins

  • The You avatar is a drawn "S" disc in S.N.I.D.E. green, standing in for the real faction avatar component.
  • The Factions side still shows that page's own eight-hue bar under the switch. In the build it goes with the old title, as the Players side's rainbow rule did here.
  • The header now holds the wordmark and MOD on the right, and MOD shows only for moderators. The bell and Settings live in You.
